Coppock Curve
This keyword returns a long-term price momentum indicator used primarily to recognize major downturns and upturns in a stock market index. It is also known as the "Coppock Guide."
You have to mention 
Wma Period 
as input for the keyword 
 
You can fetch the Coppock Curve on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot 
Coppock
 Curve of RSI, OPEN etc
Read about 
Coppock Curve 
here - 
https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/coppockcurve.asp
